Inside was a single sheet, damp but legible, written in a child's careful capitals: 'If anyone finds this, I am fine now. I was not fine then. Thank you to whoever listens.' No name, no date, no address. Elias read it four times. He lit the stove, made tea, and sat with it until the sky went grey. At sunrise he wrote his own note, sealed it in the same bottle, and threw it as far as he could.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有彻底醒来。高架桥上的路灯把橘色的光铺在空荡的路面上，像一条温吞的河。便利店的玻璃门映着冷白的光，收银员靠着货架打盹，只有关东煮的锅还在轻轻冒气。环卫工的扫帚一下一下扫过人行道，声音在楼群之间回荡，比白天清晰得多。远处的写字楼还有几扇窗亮着，不知道是谁在为一份报告熬着。风从街口穿过去，卷起一张废纸，又轻轻放下。整个城市像一台刚刚停止运转的机器，留着余温，也留着一点说不清的温柔。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a thing contains a smaller copy of itself, like a mirror facing another mirror or a set of Russian dolls.\n- In a computer program, a recursive function solves a big problem by calling itself on a smaller piece of the same problem.\n- It has to stop somewhere—that stopping rule is called the base case—otherwise it keeps calling itself forever, like asking 'why?' until everyone gives up."}
